### what_to_do_first.details[1]
Sentence: Because the Health Care Act sets no legal maximum time for a cancer suspicion and Finland lacks uniform diagnostic timetables, the team recommends reporting access times using THL guidance 21/2016 definitions (for 16 cancers) with handover alerts; the Filha National Lung Cancer Programme's diagnostics recommendation with time limits is to be carried out before the 2030 mid-term evaluation.

### what_to_do_first.details[2]
Sentence: Backed by mentor insight that a weak referral gets a lower urgency rating in specialist care, the team recommends a standard referral template, a rule to refer persistent symptoms after a normal X-ray to a pulmonologist, and a named diagnostic-phase contact; the STM roadmap (measure 1.2.3) plans care-coordinator guidance by 2026–2028 that counties adopt by 2029–2031.

flags.sentence: County treatment shares are crude, lacking age adjustment and stage adjustment, while public registry data omit pathway timestamps from symptom onset and primary care through treatment start.
